profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Elemental Technologies at Amazon Web Services
profile.summary:
Core Technologies:
* Android
* Advanced Java and JNI (1.1-1.7)
* Advanced C++/STL
* UML, XML (XSD+XSLT)
* Networking/RPC

Peripheral Technologies:
* Java Server Faces (JSF) and Facelets, Rails 3 & 4, Google Web Toolkit (GWT), Java Server Pages (JSP), Servlets, Swing, JAXB, J2ME
* Boost C++, STLport, MFC, DCOM, CORBA, GTK
* git, Subversion (svn), CVS
* HTTP, Apache/CGI, SSH, CIM, JavaScript, XUL, JSON, Flex
* Python, Bash, CSS, Ruby, Groovy
* Gradle, Make, Boost-Build, Ant, Eclipse, IntelliJ, regex
* DocBook, Microsoft Office
* GNU/Linux/Debian/Ubuntu/RedHat/SuSE, Windows, Vmware/Virtualization

Specialties: Object-Oriented Design, Design Patterns, Template Meta-Programming, Policy-Based Design, Framework Abstraction, User-Centered Design, Open Source and Standard Libraries, Cross-Platform Development, Agile Development, Automation, Test-Driven Development, Web Development, Mobile Development

company.name: AWS Elemental, an Amazon Web Services Company

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer SDEIII
positions.description:
Led the design, development and launch of AWS Elemental MediaLive, a new top level AWS service for running live video encoders at scale - launched at AWS re:Invent 2017.

Pioneered the Docker based video encoding solution and designed the encoding network architecture isolation backend.
Various patent applications and awards.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Founded organization-wide Agile development adoption and practices with explicit sprint commitments; Scrum master on the Live, Server, Conductor products for many full releases, focusing on data-driven metrics, team task estimation and self-direction.
Acted as team envoy to the Program Managers; mentored on code quality and software design.
Led the mysql to postgresql migration for Live, Server, Conductor products.
Developed numerous frontend and backend features for node management, clustering, high availability, and video pipeline management.
Created custom tools and integrations to automate the end-to-end engineering Git workflow from work branch to pull-request, and to enable developer merges to release branches after PM approval.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Created Hello Wifi Android app for secure wifi password sharing using REST, RoR, Java, Google Plus, GCM, Heroku and Google Analytics: http://hello-wifi.com
Created a lean startup proof of concept for a student-oriented social task sharing application using RoR, bootstrap, Heroku.
Created a lean startup proof of concept for a geo-location photo web linking application aiming to connect static media to the web using RoR, PostgreSQL, twitter APIs, Heroku.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Held presentations on the productivity benefits of Git and Gradle.
Created an extensible SQL template engine utilizing Ruby and HAML.
Created automated functional testing infrastructure using Ruby and Rspec.
Led development of the E-Series Storage Disk Drive Response
Time Utility project, established team-wide Java, GWT, SQL and
unit test best practices
Led development of the E-Series storage Whamcloud Chroma Storage
Plugin, emphasizing Java module reuse in a Python environment
Led storage array management scalability initiatives to support 1000's of
array controller pairs, incorporating asynchronous socket I/O and scalable
SQL database schema design
Created an annotation-based client-server architecture to simplify and
accelerate development of a command-line interface (CLI)
Continuous process improvement and wiki documentation

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of the E-Series storage Oracle VM 3.0
Storage Connect Plugin
Architected the Oracle Automated Replication Engine designed to replicate
live or suspended Oracle database installations to new host servers,
managing both core database installation and setup as well as database
volumes via native E-Series copy services

positions.title: Product Specialist IV
positions.description:
Led a team of 5 engineers to implement my design proposal for the
next generation filesystem data replication engine based on my
design of the snapshot policy engine
Led a team of 3 engineers to implement my design for the snapshot policy
engine, an integral data management component in the network-attached
storage (NAS) appliance
Created a native C++ template-based, type-safe RPC library that supported
broadcasts, exceptions, callbacks and deferred completion for rapid
inter-node communication development
Created a build tool used across all teams that abstracted cross-platform
builds, automated important build use cases and provided hooks for
post-build automation
Mentored many engineers on good development and testing practices

positions.title: Software Engineer (User Interface)
positions.description:
Led a 2 engineer team to implement my design for the
role-based access control framework, which enabled the storage and
virtual service management infrastructure to provide enterprise-level
security and authorization in a server consolidation environment,
integrated with Active Directory
Led a 2 engineer team in the investigation of a next generation web-based
user-interface prototype using Java Server Faces (JSF), Facelets, Tomcat,
custom and off-the-shelf web components that proved to be a viable
framework for adoption in the next-generation appliance
Designed and implemented many user-interface features to meet the
needs of cluster admins
Demonstrated leadership on the User Interface team by taking ownership
of common development frameworks and successfully standardizing
development tools with the Eclipse IDE
Fixed defects and applied significant stability improvements to the
Java/Swing cluster management user-interface enabling the cluster
product to ship without delay

positions.title: Distance Learning Course Instructor
positions.description:
Mentored up to 20 students at a time on UML design, Java and
C++ programming language fundamentals and good software engineering
practices for the professional development of students interested in
enhancing their skills or entering the software field
Co-authored and reviewed new course materials for the C++ Advanced and
C++ Intermediate courses to make sure the materials were up-to-date and
relevant

positions.title: Student Research Assistant / Software Developer
positions.description:
Performed hardware-accelerated intervisibility research for
multi-entity simulation using NVIDIA/GL extensions on an NVIDIA
GPU graphics card cluster
Created a Java-based robot control framework for embedded J2ME
devices
Developed a GPS/NMEA Serial Driver for embedded J2ME applications
Designed a dynamic, cluster-based spatial distribution architecture for
scalable terrain analysis

Publications
Guy Schiavone, Judd Tracy, Eric Woodruff, Troy Dere, "Design of a software
framework to support live/virtual training on distributed terrain", April 2003,
Proceedings of SPIE, Enabling Technologies for Simulation Science VII,
Orlando, FL, Paper 5091-12
Dr. Guy Schiavone, Judd Tracy, Eric Tichi, Eric Woodruff, "Cluster Computing
for Calculating Line of Sight Over a Distributed Terrain", 2003 Spring
Simulation and Interoperability Workshop, Orlando, FL, Paper 03S-SIW-068

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed PinPoint Monitor from the ground up, a
Windows-based medium-scale application in C++ for acquisition,
visualization, logging and processing of data acquired using analog-digital
conversion hardware that enabled scientists to accurately record
laboratory experiments
Maintained and extended a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) software
control system for environmentally sensitive water baths and isolation
chambers

honors.title: Elemental Quarterly Exemplary Core Value Award for Innovation
honors.description: For development tools and process innovation
honors.issuer: Issued by Sam Blackman, CEO · Apr 2015

honors.title: NetApp Innovation Award, FY13
honors.description: "NetApp honors the exceptional accomplishments and technology leadership of Eric Woodruff for his work on developing a host utility that gathers statistics from E-Series Arrays to provide historical data and analysis on each drive of the storage arrays monitored by EOS software."
honors.issuer: Issued by Steven Kleiman Senior Vice President and Chief Scientist, Jay Kidd Senior Vice President and Chief Technology Officer · Jun 2013

projects.title: Hello Wifi
projects.description: With Hello Wifi you can securely share your wifi hotspot or router password, follow your friends' hotspots, and get notified about other hotspots you can follow nearby.

projects.title: Password Hasher Plus for Google Chrome
projects.description: Password Hasher Plus automatically enhances password strength (length and difficulty) to protect your accounts.
